_comment: Small, HIGH-CONFIDENCE curated list of well-known vulnerable dependency versions, matched DETERMINISTICALLY by sca.py so they are always flagged regardless of model variance. Conservative on purpose: only rock-solid, widely-documented cases. 'prefix' matches any version starting with it; 'max' flags versions <= it. Severity is honest; framed as 'known-vulnerable pinned version — verify against the advisory DB and bump'. The LLM still adds the long tail on top.

entries.name: System.Net.Http
entries.advisory: legacy System.* 4.3.x transitive package with published advisories (e.g. CVE-2017-0247/0248/0249/0256, CVE-2018-8292 family)
entries.fixed: use the in-box framework assembly / a maintained version

entries.name: System.Private.Uri
entries.advisory: legacy System.* 4.3.x transitive package with published advisories
entries.fixed: remove the explicit pin / use the in-box assembly

entries.name: pyyaml
entries.advisory: PyYAML < 5.4 — arbitrary code execution via full_load/unsafe load (CVE-2020-14343)

entries.name: node-fetch
entries.advisory: node-fetch < 2.6.7 — SSRF / information exposure on redirect (CVE-2022-0235)

entries.name: requests
entries.advisory: requests < 2.20.0 — credential leak on redirect to a different host (CVE-2018-18074)

entries.name: urllib3
entries.advisory: urllib3 < 1.24.2 — CRLF injection / improper cert validation (CVE-2019-11324, CVE-2019-11236)

entries.name: cryptography
entries.advisory: cryptography < 3.3.2 — OpenSSL buffer overflow in Fernet (CVE-2020-36242)

entries.name: jackson-databind
entries.advisory: jackson-databind < 2.9.10.8 — polymorphic deserialization RCE gadgets (multiple CVEs)

entries.name: snakeyaml
entries.advisory: SnakeYAML < 1.26 — unsafe constructor RCE / billion-laughs (CVE-2017-18640, CVE-2022-1471)
